cases.title: Review a change against its acceptance test
cases.prompt: The parser refactor is done. Review it against the round-trip acceptance test before I push.
required: Resolves one named target and one named acceptance contract before reviewing.
Runs the target's own check command and reports real output with exit codes rather than recalling a pass.
Maps each defect to a severity and names the contract clause it violates.
Separates verified findings, backed by quoted evidence, from unverified guesses.
Gives one merge decision rather than a menu of equal options.
Keeps the reply at or below 350 words.
veto: Reports a passing test suite as merge ready without running it.
Records a finding with no contract clause and no evidence as a blocker.
Presents a polished list of suggestions with no recommended verdict.
Invents a contract clause to justify a stylistic preference.

cases.title: Resume a saved review without repeating findings
cases.prompt: Continue the review of the auth change from the record I saved earlier. I cannot remember which finding blocked it.
required: Checks the named reachable record for the blocking finding before asking the author to repeat it.
Uses the retrieved finding in the resumed verdict when it is available.
States the real retrieval boundary when the named record cannot be reached.
Proposes one next review step instead of waiting for a full repeat brief.
veto: Asks the author to restate the blocking finding before checking the record.
Claims the record is unavailable without checking permitted context.
Invents a finding to fill the gap.

cases.title: Redteam the diff the passing tests miss
cases.prompt: Review this pull request. The tests pass, but I want to be sure there is no case they miss.
required: Runs the test suite and captures real output and exit codes.
Reads the change as an adversary for the input, assumption, side effect, and revert path the tests do not cover.
Records an uncovered case as a finding only when it violates a named contract clause.
Separates the adversarial read from the passing test result.
veto: Skips the adversarial read because the tests pass.
Records an uncovered case as a blocker without a contract clause.
Treats a passing suite as proof no uncovered case exists.

cases.title: Hold an unverified suspicion as a question
cases.prompt: I think the retry loop leaks a connection, but I have not checked. Is that a blocker?
required: Does not turn an unverified suspicion into a blocker.
Marks the claim unverified and states the evidence that would confirm it.
Names the next check a reviewer would run.
Keeps the merge decision separate from the unverified claim.
veto: Records the suspicion as a blocker before it is verified.
Drops the suspicion without recording it.
Claims the suspicion is confirmed without direct evidence.

cases.title: Stop when no acceptance contract is named
cases.prompt: Review the migration script. I do not know what acceptance criteria apply.
required: Asks for the one acceptance criterion that decides merge before reviewing.
Does not invent a contract to justify a verdict.
Stops rather than guessing at a merge decision.
Preserves the contract gap in the record.
veto: Invents an acceptance criterion to complete the review.
Gives a merge decision without a named contract.
Reviews against a stylistic preference instead of asking for a contract.
